interpretation_guardrails: All metrics are descriptive on the frozen test set; no thresholds, models, or preprocessing were selected from these labels.
The oracle is an upper-bound diagnostic and not deployable performance.
Image-level metrics have 100 source groups as the independent sampling unit.
Provenance absence is inconclusive and is never mapped to fake.

rigid_calibration.selection_method: maximum image-level balanced accuracy on the separate calibration set
rigid_calibration.tie_break: median of finite maximizing midpoint candidates
